entities.name: Tigaden
entities.description: Dwarf village in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia on Dominaria.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Mountains in Sarpadia where dragon eggs hatch.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Region of Dominaria containing the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Melelki
entities.description: Dwarf woman and poor embroiderer who sold dragon eggs to Reod Dai.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Man who offered to buy dragon eggs from Melelki at 2 gold apiece.

events.summary: A dragon whelp wanders into Tigaden looking for food and is killed after bloodying five dwarves.
events.quote: a dragon whelp wander into the village, looking for food

events.summary: Melelki meets Reod Dai at the Squat Duck, who offers 2 gold apiece for dragon eggs; they trade yearly for 3 years.
events.quote: He offered to buy dragon eggs from her for 2 gold apiece

relations.quote: Each year for a total of 3 years they repeated the trade
